input: MATCH (u:Person) WHERE u.person_id = 7 MATCH (u)-[r:RECOMMENDED]->(s:Skill) RETURN s.skill_id AS item, r.propensity AS p ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT 50
MATCH (u:Person)-[:HAS_SKILL]->(s:Skill) WHERE u.person_id = 7 AND s.track = 'mgmt' RETURN s.title AS title
